title: Financial IQ factorBreakdown (v2)
description: Returned as a JSON object in `factorBreakdown` by Financial IQ (`GET /api/financial-iq/{userId}/latest`) and by Finance Profile (`POST /api/Profiles/{userId}/calculate-iq`). v1 sent the same data as a JSON string, with a 6th factor RiskAlignment and a riskProfile object; both were removed in v2 (no self-reported risk). Changes need the approval of both developers; new fields must be optional.

version.description: Scoring rules that produced the result. Absent = v1.

factors.description: Points each factor earned. Maximums: CashReserveMonths 25, DebtToIncomeRatio 25, SavingsRate 25, ExpenseRatio 15, Impatience 10 (sum 100). When appliedRule is set, every factor is at its maximum (100 rules) or 0 (EXTREME_DEBT), so the bars still add up to the score.

appliedRule.description: null = the 5 factors decided the score. VERY_HIGH_INCOME: monthly income >= 1,000,000 and net debt <= 1 year of income -> 100. VERY_HIGH_WEALTH: cash + investments - total debt >= 10,000,000 -> 100. EXTREME_DEBT: net debt >= 100,000,000 with income < 1,000,000 -> 0. The coach must explain a rule-decided score by the rule, not by the ratios.
